caption_output_formats.description: SubRip format. Timecode-indexed captions with sequence numbers. Human-readable, widely supported.
caption_output_formats.use_case: Universal fallback. Supported by nearly all platforms for manual upload.

caption_output_formats.description: WebVTT format. Web Video Text Tracks. Similar to SRT with styling support. Recommended for web.
caption_output_formats.use_case: Web-based players, HTML5 video elements. Supports styling (CSS).

caption_output_formats.description: JSON structure: array of caption entries with timecode and text. Machine-readable.
caption_output_formats.use_case: Internal processing, programmatic caption manipulation, database storage.

transcription_configuration.description: Local transcription via Whisper.cpp (no cloud APIs). Fallback to commercial API if quality unacceptable.

burn_in_configuration.description: Captions can be hardcoded (rendered) into video frames during composition.
use_cases: Mobile platforms without caption support (TikTok, Instagram)
Videos with audio issues requiring visual fallback

external_caption_support.notes: Upload as subtitle track. YouTube auto-generates if not provided.

caption_style_metadata.background_color: hex or rgb (default: '#000000' black with 0.7 alpha)

timing_source.primary: audio_duration (video length determined by audio track length)

fallback_behavior.if_transcription_fails: output_caption_template_json with null entries; require manual review before export
fallback_behavior.if_burn_in_fails: export_external_captions_only; user notified to add captions manually or retry
fallback_behavior.if_both_fail: output_incomplete_warning; user must choose to proceed without captions or retry
